1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 1 concurrent parcel; 28-unit openings, 1.5-unit/s belt, seeded wind and drifting shutters. Each completed tether action advances one fixed transport segment; waiting is stable.
1.natural_language: Steer every parcel through both growing frames and the drifting exit. Track each visible opening and correct the inertial pull after deliberate tether actions. One collision ends the episode.
